sections.name: architecture
sections.value: Doctrine: .agents/skills/pij-team/TENETS.md. TypeScript-only, inside the pi/omp extension. Touch: `.pi/extensions/pij/index.ts` (two call sites :321 and :364-371) + a new small module `.pi/extensions/pij/core/session-name.ts` holding the pure retry/fallback helper so it is testable with a fake pi API, + its test. The helper takes narrow deps: {setSessionName, getSessionName?, setStatus, notice, sleep} — never the whole ctx. Read the vendored diagnosis assets/inputs/diagnosis.md first; the omp bridge and boolean exits are documented there with the exact dist snippets. Runtime detection stays `detectPiRuntime` (core/discovery.ts:51-57). NO changes outside these paths; if getSessionName is not exposed through the extension API, say so and fall back to bounded blind retries + status + notice.

value.rationale: One helper, two call sites, one test file. PM codes it, proves 10/10 live in hand-started omps, then dispatches the Claude reviewer.

value.name: session-name publisher
value.responsibility: publishSeatName(deps, self): retries setSessionName on a bounded schedule until readback matches (or attempts exhausted), always sets the pij status key, emits one notice on final failure; returns {took:boolean, attempts:number}. index.ts calls it from both generation paths and re-invokes once on first inbound delivery if it had not taken.
value.interface: export async function publishSeatName(deps: {setSessionName(name:string):Promise<unknown>; getSessionName?():string|undefined; setStatus(key:string,text:string):void; notice(text:string):void; sleep(ms:number):Promise<void>}, self: string, schedule?: number[]): Promise<{took:boolean; attempts:number}>
value.test_strategy: vitest with a fake: fails 2 then succeeds → took=true attempts=3, status set once; never succeeds → took=false, notice exactly once, status set; readback available and already equal → 1 attempt. RED-first: run each new test against the pre-fix index.ts behaviour (helper absent) and paste the red.
value.note: Do not spam: schedule is bounded; the first-delivery re-invoke is a single extra attempt.

value.mode: solo-pm in the plan worktree (~/pi-hacking/fs3-omp-statusline-name, branch 125-omp-statusline-name)
value.note: Default: each coder gets its own worktree, branching off the PM's plan branch; unit lands back onto the plan branch (PM merges — coders never merge). Shared-tree work is the retro-proven #1 hazard (staged sweeps, untrustworthy greens) — only choose it for trivially disjoint single-wave work, and then file-scoped `git add` only, never -A. REMEMBER: fences partition WRITE intent, not the build — a mid-refactor sibling can still break your compile, so waves must respect build dependencies, and a broken workspace build is a PM composition concern, not a coder's to fix cross-fence.

value.steps: Wire the helper at both call sites; `just typecheck`, extension vitest, `harness checks` green; then the live AC1/AC2 runs in hand-started omps (window per omp, close them after capture — tidy tmux).
value.integration_proof: assets/live-footers.md: 10 footer captures with pij ids + the forced-miss transcript.

value.when: after composition (or after solo-pm coding), before the PR into main
value.inputs: plan.dd.md + this impl-guide + full branch diff; priority = plan promises, composition seams, interface drift, correctness, contract-test gaps
